_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows moving ±2+ points and no visible breaker — fed_liquidity at 0 anchoring thrust while cross-asset divergences (VIX, gold, MVRV) counter the ETF-flow narrative — the coil holds and HOLD is the skilled call.
next_move.brains_agree: Both agree on Disbelief phase and HOLD direction, but split on conviction: Analyst hedges medium with divergence caveats while Narrative leans more bullish at 0.72 confidence on the ETF-flow story.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks above 70 with funding rising above 0.02% and VIX collapsing below 12
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with btc_momentum_30d dropping below 50 and exchange_netflow flipping above 80 (inflow panic)
